image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a black hockey puck resting on a dark surface. The top face features a prominent blue and white shield-shaped logo in the center, surrounded by a ring of illegible, distorted white text that resembles gibberish. The side edge shows vertical ridges typical of a hockey puck.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object clearly exhibits the correct aspect ratio of a standard hockey puck (diameter > thickness).
The geometry is consistent with a solid disk; no internal structures or transparency issues are visible.
The base material is black with a semi-matte finish, reflecting light softly rather than like polished plastic.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Raised ridges or grooves around circumference for stick handling.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Vertical striations/ridges are clearly visible on the side wall of the puck.

artifact_observations.location: Top face, surrounding the central logo
artifact_observations.reasoning: The ring of white characters is structurally incoherent. The letters merge into each other, vary wildly in height, and do not form any recognizable words or standard font glyphs. This is a classic AI generation failure in rendering text.

The blue logo has a 'painted-on' or decal-like quality that lacks the subtle integration with the rubber texture seen in real printed pucks. The edges of the blue fill bleed slightly into the black background.
